Name: Aggressive Raider
Description: Prioritizes fast military production, early cavalry harassment, wedge formations, aggressive flanking, and lower retreat thresholds.

Name: Defensive Bastion
Description: Focuses on stone fortifications, defensive towers, Square and ShieldWall formations, high-ground staging, and cautious retreats.

Name: Imperial Expansionist
Description: Rapidly expands economy and worker population, secures secondary resource nodes, and launches massive late-game combined-arms deathballs.

Name: Tactical Mastermind
Description: Focuses on hero leveling and preservation, coordinated focus firing, flanking cavalry maneuvers, terrain elevation bonuses, and dynamic formation counter-picks.
